title: Sean McVay: I've seen improvement at OTAs, but it isn't real football until we put pads on

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay: I've seen improvement at OTAs, but it isn't real football until we put pads on
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay is liking what he's seeing at Organized Team Activities, but he's tempering his enthusiasm with a reminder that what he's seeing is not actually football.
